summary.goal: Visual indicators for each planning agent showing their current state, with interaction affordances for viewing activity and answering questions.

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentAvatar component renders icon/emoji for agent role
Avatar shows 'working' state with green pulsing dot
Avatar shows 'needs input' state with red ring indicator
Avatar shows 'idle' state with dimmed opacity
Avatar shows 'error' state with warning icon
Hover shows tooltip with current status/activity
Click on working agent opens ActivityPopover
Click on needs-input agent opens ChatBubble
ActivityPopover shows current thought snippet and 'View Full Trajectory' link

steps.title: Create AgentAvatar component
steps.description: Component with role prop (maps to emoji), state prop (normal/working/needs_input/idle/error), size prop (sm/md/lg)
acceptance: Renders correct emoji for each role
Shows state indicator (green dot, red ring, dimmed, warning)

steps.title: Add state indicator animations
steps.description: Green pulsing dot for working, red ring for needs_input (with escalation animation at 2min+), dimmed for idle
acceptance: Working state has animate-pulse on green dot
Needs input has ring that thickens over time

steps.title: Create AgentActivityPopover component
steps.description: Popover that shows on click when agent is working. Shows role, current activity, step title, thought preview, 'View Trajectory' link
acceptance: Popover appears above avatar on click

steps.title: Add tooltip on hover
steps.description: Simple tooltip showing role label and brief status on hover
acceptance: Tooltip appears on hover after 300ms delay
Shows role name and status text

steps.title: Define agent roles configuration
steps.description: Create AGENT_ROLES constant with id, icon (emoji), label for each role type
acceptance: Architect, UI Designer, Data Modeler, Coder, Tester, Security defined
